name: Chart/Heatmap-Chart
description:
Heatmap chart: a value per row × column (hour × weekday) as 24px cells (Corner-Radius/Small, Spacing/Gap/2XSmall apart) on the 5-step Support/Brand ramp (Pale, Soft, Solid, Rich, Deep); the active cell takes a 2px Border/Neutral/Solid ring, its Tooltip and lit row/column labels; Less→More scale (Caption/Regular, 12px steps) at the end. Content only, no surface of its own: place it in a Chart-Card's (or a Card's) Content slot, and the card gives the theme. Code: HeatmapChart + ChartCard (src/components/Chart)


Header: Title · Show Hint — an info icon (20px, Content/Neutral/Light) that holds the chart's description in a Tooltip (code: hint) · Show Open; Show Icon is off by default (chart headers carry no icon). Metric: Show Metric Label (Body/Small/Regular, what the figure is; code: metricLabel) over Show Value (Display/4).
